features.feature_value: Explicit reference to the Second Amendment and gun policy

features.rationale: The post centers its argument on Second Amendment undermining and related gun-policy disputes.
The speaker contrasts an outgroup ideological/racial grouping as the actor driving the alleged policy change.

features.feature_value: Uses insulting profanity to dismiss opponents
features.rationale: The post employs strong profanity as a direct dismissal of a group.

features.rationale: It frames legitimacy as tied to generational membership and asserts a right to decide who belongs.

features.feature_value: Begins with dependency qualifier then offers aligned/disaligned positions
features.rationale: The message explicitly conditions its stance on the topic before stating support and disagreement.

features.feature_value: Non-negotiable rights framing and coercion/moral claims

features.feature_value: Directly argues against coercion with moral justification
features.rationale: The communicative intent is persuasive/justificatory, grounding opposition to restrictions in moral/righs-based rhetoric.

features.rationale: The post packages policy conflict around a headline-style event using many hashtags and emotive descriptors.
